WITH ins AS (
               INSERT INTO agents.work_item_attention (session_id, kind, subject, since, message)
               VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
               ON CONFLICT (session_id, kind, subject) DO NOTHING
               RETURNING id, delivery_attempts, last_delivery_attempt_at, disposition
           )
           SELECT ins.id AS "id!", true AS "inserted!", false AS "delivered!",
                  ins.delivery_attempts AS "delivery_attempts!",
                  ins.last_delivery_attempt_at AS "last_delivery_attempt_at",
                  ins.disposition AS "disposition!"
             FROM ins
           UNION ALL
           SELECT a.id, false, a.delivered_message_uuid IS NOT NULL,
                  a.delivery_attempts, a.last_delivery_attempt_at, a.disposition
             FROM agents.work_item_attention a
            WHERE a.session_id = $1 AND a.kind = $2 AND a.subject = $3
              AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins)
